ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 75% of the visible fluke surface, with low-intensity black pixels localized to the trailing edges and median notch area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous zones cover the central and leading regions of both lobes; black pixel mottling is concentrated in the lower-central region near the notch and as a continuous boundary along the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate 45-degree angle of convergence; depth extends approximately 12-15% into the vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; sharp, non-uniform peaks are particularly visible on the distal ends of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve on the leading edges; trailing edges show a segmented linear sweep with an upward inclination towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of black pixels (3-10 pixels in diameter) distributed across the white mid-lobes, most prominent on the lower portion of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, diagonal black pixel lines (rake marks) are detected on the inner region of the right lobe, oriented toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavily pigmented dark region extending from the median notch into the lower body; isolated high-contrast dark spots on the distal portion of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Alphanumeric timestamp overlay in the bottom-left quadrant reading 'AUG. 9 2001' and '5:06:34 PM' in a high-contrast outlined font.
